sources.scope_correction: IMPORTANT: this book is not a skirmish-scale variant of Oathmark. It is the first Oathmark supplement, covering three things: (1) Battle Honours — an optional persistent-veteran-unit system with a hard 3-honour cap, a compounding 10% cost tax per honour, spend-not-store reroll tokens, and a d10 destroyed-unit table; (2) water/river rules, boats, and engineer units; (3) three linked 'Military Expedition' mini-campaign scenario chains plus new Unique Territories. All still at Oathmark's native mass-battle scale (units of 9-20+ figures). The word 'skirmish' appears exactly twice in the text and both times means a small on-water engagement, not a game-scale mode. Corrected here rather than silently reinterpreted.

sources.notes: Covers: Special Formations (reuse existing owned units in new tactical modes — Phalanx, Square, Skirmish formation — explicitly marketed by the designer as growth 'without having to buy or paint new units'); Kingdom Events chapter (a D10 category roll -> sub-table system for between-battle texture, ~40-60% no-event, six categories: Political/Internal/External/Natural/Magical/Miscellaneous, plus a deliberately non-mechanical 'Passage of Time' flavour-only sub-table); two new Unique Territories (The High Seat, Prison of the Ice Queen). Also contains the ONE documented exception to 'growth never costs budget' found across all three books: the Land Purchase political event lets a kingdom buy a new Region 5 territory outside of combat, at a cost of -10% points in the next battle.
